mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through continuous valuation effects without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC of FEDFUNDS against 20-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 4.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC of UNRATE against 5-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200 thousand units and real consumption (RSAFS) below 520000 million dollars signal broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through joint economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST < 1200 and RSAFS < 520000 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC of interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 4.0% and FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 105) signals impending economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate activity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 105 in late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 4.0 and FEDFUNDS > 3.0) over any 3-year window (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through continuous economic momentum.
failure_condition: Rank IC of PAYEMS against 5-day forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1300 thousand units signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive when HOUST > 1300 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC of HOUST against 60-day returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 255) signals aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through joint policy effects.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 255 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC of interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 255), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 105) signals economic deceleration, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced manufacturing activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 105 in monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 255) over any 3-year window (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC is below 0.03.
